charts.title: SRME by family (0 = experiment)
charts.help: Symmetric relative mean error per stiffness family; 0 means the measured value. The source paper reports the fitted constants themselves (the table below); SRME is this campaign's cross-model metric, not the paper's plot.

charts.title: signed error (model − experiment)
charts.help: Auxiliary view: the same constants as signed errors, so too-stiff and too-soft read differently — SRME folds both into one magnitude.

table.note: |P| is the mean |diagonal| of the residual virial. The lr selection does not read it -- it ranks the tail-mean training loss -- so this column is a check on the reported run, not a gate it passed.

train:diamond:exp_only.title: diamond · exp_only — training
train:diamond:exp_only.sub: Per-epoch history.json. The tail-5 loss column is what selects the rate; the SRME here is the 2 fs reweighted trajectory's own estimate, NOT the reported evaluation — the two disagreed by 17% on MACE/diamond, which is why no column here is a gate. Colour = model, dash = learning rate; seed0 is the promoted run and seed1/seed2 are its replicates at the same rate.

charts.title: effective sample fraction
charts.help: Fraction of the reweighted trajectory still carrying weight; a statepoint regenerates when this falls under the config's reweight_ratio, so the curve is the sawtooth, not the threshold it bounces off.
